title: Successor finite-sum comparison after pushforward
statement: For a morphism i : Z ⟶ X, natural number r, and ideal sheaf data I on Z, the pushforward of the (r+1)-fold finite biproduct of I is isomorphic to the biproduct of the pushforward of the r-fold finite biproduct and the pushforward of I.

proof.text: Construct the filtration by composing the old chain with the split inclusion into the biproduct, append the full object, and transport coherence and quotient witnesses across the resulting isomorphisms.
